points.display: The question before this House is simple: Will we help Ukraine negotiate from a position of strength, or will we help Putin outlast American resolve? The Ukrainian people, our NATO allies, and the United States national security cannot afford to wait any longer for this body to act against Russia's brutal war in Ukraine.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, the question before this House is simple: 
Will we help Ukraine negotiate from a position of strength, or will we 
help Putin outlast American resolve?
  The Ukrainian people, our NATO allies, and the United States national 
security cannot afford to wait any longer for this body to act against 
Russia's brutal war in Ukraine.
points.speaker: Gregory W. Meeks

points.display: In the 2 years since we last approved a package, Ukrainians have endured two bitter winters of war. It is time for us to act. Russian drones have continued to rain terror on civilian neighborhoods.
points.quote:
